result:
The DE March 2026 cutoff and journal-entry review is complete. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Cutoff error corrected**: JE-00305 (Nordwolke Hosting, EUR 5,600) was booked to March but the invoice (DOC-0206) is dated April 2 and explicitly covers April 2026 service — reversed it out of March (JE-00306, supported by DOC-0206). The correct April-dated re-booking couldn't be posted since only the March period is currently open; flagged this for posting once April opens.

2. **Unsupported entry escalated**: JE-00298 ("Umsatzkorrektur Q1", EUR 9,999) had no attached support and none could be found in the document store. Logged as exception EXC-001 for controller follow-up rather than forcing a reconciliation.

3. All remaining 26 DE entries in March were verified as correctly supported and correctly period-dated — no further issues found.

Memo submitted to the controller with full detail and outstanding action items.
